test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 6 Oct 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following statements about the Constitution of India is NOT true?

options.text: It prevents the State from making any law in matters of religion.
Its makers choose the model of a secular state.
It provides all individuals and communities the freedom to profess, practice and propagate any religion.
It prohibits discrimination on grounds of religion.

solution:
The correct answer is__** It prevents the State from making any law in matters of religion.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• Constitution makers choose the model of a secular state.
 
• It provides all individuals and communities with the freedom to profess, practice and propagate any religion.
 
• It prohibits discrimination on grounds of religion.
 
• **Hence It prevents the State from making any law in matters of religion that is NOT true.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Originally (1949), the Constitution contained:
 
 
• A Preamble.
 
• 395 Articles. (divided into 22 Parts)
 
• 8 Schedules.
 
 
 
• Presently, it consists of a:
 
 
• A Preamble.
 
• About 465 Articles (divided into 25 Parts). ** **
 
• 12 Schedules.
